_readme: Live-performance video inventory. Seeded by hand from the six YouTube links sent to Cheryl (2026-09-02); tools/capture-videos.py fills title/duration/uploadDate/poster from YouTube metadata and downloads the MP4s to Video/live/ (gitignored). Upload the MP4s to the Supabase 'artist-video' bucket so `src` resolves; until then pages/videos.html falls back to the YouTube embed automatically. ARCHIVE: `python3 tools/capture-videos.py archive --list` enumerates every L.A. Young clip on the channels behind these links (plus any URLs in archiveSources); drop --list to download them all to Video/archive/.
